title: Big Globe x Companions! Compatibility
description: Makes Companions! structures spawn in Big Globe worlds.
body:
Makes it so that [Companions!](https://modrinth.com/project/ArBFNu9T) structures spawn in [Big Globe](https://modrinth.com/mod/big-globe) worlds. Make sure to change the Companions! config, else the golden allay, cornelius, nor antlion will spawn.

Consider [Sparse Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/sparsestructures) if youre not happy with the amount of buildings, or [Explorers Compass](https://modrinth.com/project/RV1qfVQ8) if youre having trouble finding them.







Spawn locations are as follows:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Babayaga: **#bigglobe:swamps**

Factory: **bigglobe:warm_plains** and **bigglobe:temperate_plains**

Monkey Temple: **bigglobe:warm_dense_forest** and **bigglobe:temperate_dense_forest**

Teddytower: **bigglobe:warm_dense_forest** and **bigglobe:temperate_dense_forest**

Imp Tent: **bigglobe:nether_wastes** and **bigglobe:ashen_wastes** at exactly Y=65, meaning at the lava lakes at the bottom of the nether. I have not figured out how to stop them from spawning inside terrain yet, so explorers compass won't be all that helpful in finding tents.

</details>



NOTE: On version 1.20.1 teddytowers and monkey temples are still incrediby rare.
